TITLE: Step 3.5 Flash: Open Frontier-Level Intelligence with 11B Active Parameters  
AUTHORS: StepFun Team  
VENUE: AIME 2025  
ONE-LINE TAKEAWAY: Step 3.5 Flash achieves frontier-level intelligence with only 11B active parameters (196B MoE), matching leading models like GPT-5.2 xHigh and Gemini 3.0 Pro on reasoning and agentic tasks.  
- Agentic systems require low latency for real-time interaction, but long-context inference is computationally expensive.  
- Current post-training methods struggle with scalable reinforcement learning and efficient expert iteration in sparse Mixture-of-Experts models.  
- Uses a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture with 196B total parameters and 11B active per token.  
- Employs hybrid attention with 3:1 ratio of Sliding Window Attention (SWA) to Full Attention.  
- Implements Multi-Token Prediction (MTP-3) for speculative decoding to reduce latency.  
- Applies head-wise gated attention and GQA-8 for hardware-aligned efficiency.  
- Uses Metropolis Independence Sampling-Filtered Policy Optimization (MIS-PO) for stable RL training.  
- Achieves 85.4% accuracy on IMO-AnswerBench.  
- Achieves 86.4% accuracy on LiveCodeBench-v6 (2024.08–2025.05).  
- Achieves 88.2% accuracy on 𝜏2-Bench.  
- Achieves 69.0% accuracy on BrowseComp (with Context Manage).  
- Achieves 51.0% accuracy on Terminal-Bench 2.0.  
- 11B: active parameters during inference (out of 196B total).  
- 85.4%: accuracy on IMO-AnswerBench.  
- 88.2%: accuracy on 𝜏2-Bench.  
- 170 tokens/s: inference speed on Hopper GPUs during first week on OpenRouter.  
- Figure 1: Shows Step 3.5 Flash's performance across multiple benchmarks compared to leading models, highlighting its high accuracy with minimal active parameters.
